description: An advanced email control agent that reads, summarizes, marks as read, deletes, organizes, and analyzes emails using the Gmail Digest MCP API toolset. It classifies relevance, manages mailbox state, compares emails to spam/skip lists, and handles errors, supporting both Gmail and Yahoo providers.
name: client-comms-agent
